about: Lab games that came in before D-579 without all of their canons, as public/labs/canons.test.mjs names them: manifest (game.json, so the conformance suite runs), cover (a landing in tools/e2e/paths.mjs that landing-fold.mjs measures), exits (salidasFin, C-19), rankings (finDePartida, bloqueTabla or avisoPartida, C-19), dialogs (coverWithDialogs, C-8), signals (trackStart and trackFinish, C-7), spec (docs/games/<folder>.md, C-13), e2e (a play script and languages.mjs in tools/e2e/<folder>/, C-12). A ratchet: each list only shrinks and no new game joins; a game pays its debt before it leaves the lab. Games parked in La Bodega are outside the gate (no maintenance) and carry no debt.
